༄༅/ /thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'phrin las rab rgyas zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen ba

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'phrin las rab rgyas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i gzugs/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang gdugs dkar srid na gsal/ /bla ma mchog dang dbyer med la btud de/ /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg nus 'byin 'chad la spro/ /thugs rje chen po'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ sbyin sreg la bzhi ste/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid do/ /spyi'i sbyin sreg la bzhi las/ dang po zhi ba'i sbyin sreg la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba thab ni sngar sa chog ma byas pa'i sa phyogs yin na gang du bya ba'i gnas su rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas gtor ma cha gsum cho ga bzhin btang la/ dang po gnyis kyi 'phrin las bcol gyi rjes su/ sa phyogs 'dir 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ lha mchod pa dang sems can gyi don bgyid par 'tshal na sa yi phyogs 'di bdag la bstsal zhing sbyin sreg gi cho ga mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i sdong grogs mdzad du gsol zhes brjod de gshegs gsol sogs bya/ bgegs gtor gyi rjes su sa yi phyogs 'dir sogs gong ltar las 'tshal na zhes pa'i mthar 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba rnams gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la sa yi phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig ces dang khro bo'i sngags brjod cing rol mo bya/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs dkar gyi phyogs kun du brabs pas bgegs thams cad byer bar bsam pa ni sa blang ba'o/ /de nas lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos oṃ bhrūṃ khaṃ zhes brjod cing dkyil 'khor gyi sa phyogs thams cad lag pas bcag la sa phyogs nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsam/ de bzhin du oṃ ha na ha na kro ngha hūm̐ phaṭa ces mang du brjod pas sa phyogs skyon thams cad dang bral bar bsam pa ni sa sbyang ba'o/

/der zhi ba'i thab khung brus pa'am/ brtsegs pa'i/ bris thab stabs gang bde lag len ltar bya/ thab kyi dbus su spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs rang gang byed kyi lha tshogs kyi mtshan ma 'god dgos la/ 'dir gtso 'khor gsum pa'i dbang du byas nas/ de'i mtshan ma me tog tshom bu'am rdul tshon sogs kyis tshom bu bkod/ zhal 'jig pa'i nub tu phyogs pa'i dbang du byas/ bud shing ni tsher ma can ma yin pa 'o ma can gyi shing sor yam shing gi tshad kyang 'di nyid do brgyad pa yan chad khru gang tsam brtsigs/ de ma 'byor na srog chags med pa'i ba lang sogs kyi lci bas thab kyi kha khyer gyi steng nas zlum por brtsigs la nang gi shar lhor ting lo che ba zhig kyang bzhag go /me ni rdo dang lcags gtsubs pa las byung ba ma yin pa rgyun bzhag gi me'am 'o ma can gtsubs sogs las byung ba'o/ /rdzas ni/ bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas dang gtor ma dang ku sha'i chun po la sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams gtsang zhing gya nom pa sta gon bya'o/ /bsham thabs ni/ thab kyi mtha' skor thams cad byi dor legs par byas la dri bzang pos byug thab kyi nub tu sgrub pa po'i stan nang 'tshang can sogs shar du phyogs par bya/ mdun du rdor dril gyi bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar la bzhag dri bzang gi chu ku sha'i 'thor yab dang bcas pa dang / grub na thab dang sgrub pa po'i bar du/ 'jim pa las byas pa'i me yol dkar zhal gyis byugs pa waṃ yig dkar po bris pa'ang bsham/ rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas nas chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod dang / 'phags pa dang / me lha la zlum gtor re bsham/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon phyogs su rang ngos nas brtsam te thab kyi g.yon nas/ yam shing mar til zas mchog dang / /'bras dang so ba nas sran ma/ /gro dang dur ba ku sha rnams/ /lag len ji bzhin legs par bsham/ /rdzas rnams bsdu na yam shing / til dkar nag

mar dang gsum mo/ /ku sha'i chun po brgyad dang dpal 'bar rnams gang bder bzhag yo byad thams cad dri bzang gis chus gtor te bzhag go /snga dro'i dus su rang nyid khrus byas 'byor na gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag nyid sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du sngags kyi lhag chad kha bskang zhing nus pa dbyung ba dang sdig pa dang / bar chad zhi ba'i phyir sbyin sreg gi cho ga la 'jug snyam pa'i bsam pa brtan pos sngar bshad pa'i rten la kha shar du bltas dkyil krung ngam/ pus 'khyud dang bcas pa'i tsog pu rkang pa gnyis cung zad bsnol ba rig byed 'don pa lta bu spyod lam gyis 'dug go /dngos gzhi la bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma'am/ rje mus chen nam/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa lta bu rang stabs gang bde'i bdag bskyed bya/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub kyi bar la lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' ba la bslab/ dpal 'bar la gong du bshad pa'i me sbar te/ lag pa gnyis su gus pa'i tshul gyis thab la g.yas nas zlum por bskor zhing ma ṇi lan gsum brjod la/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la ram/ zhes brjod de/ thab kyi nang gi ting lo sbar la me gso/ de nas khu tshur bcang ba'i mthe bong brkyang ba byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang gzar blug bzung la/ blug gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg cing blug gzar gyi mar bud shing la khyab par blugs te/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la raṃ zhes brjod/ thab dang yo byad bsang ba ni/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis bsang chu la oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces nyer gcig la sogs pa bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas sngags de nyid brjod cing ku sha'i 'thor yab kyis thab dang yo byad rnams la gtor/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas bsang /

swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dang / yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams dwang shing thogs pa med pa so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes brjod la mchod rdzas rnams rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs/ bsreg rdzas rnams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hās yam shing / oṃ shri'i swā hās mar/ oṃ dzriṃ swā hās 'bru/ oṃ swa swā hās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas thams cad sbyangs/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ya swā hā/ zhes sogs rdzas sngags rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs so/ /thab swā bhā was stong par sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rgyar khru gang ba/ dpangs su khru phyed pa kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ thab kyi nang du raṃ las me dkar gsal du 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ me lha rwa skyes dkar po la chibs pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lus po me yi rang bzhin dmar po/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/

gsus khyim che ba ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ sma ra dang smin ma dkar ser 'bar ba/ ag tshom 'phyang ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐ bsam/ de'i thugs kha'i raṃ dang rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / lag pa gnyis mthe bong gung mo'i rtsar bzhag mdzub mos gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing / tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa'i mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga ghaṇḍe ra ṇi rol mo bcas mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal por ḍa kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jig byed mi lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam ste/

ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes ba'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /des bdag la bgegs med cing zhi bar mdzod/ oṃ badzra sa twa a zhes brjod cing thab kyi mdun nas g.yas bskor gyi rim pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du dgram mo/ /de nas bsang chus phyogs kun tu gtor te a mri ta'am yakṣa brjod pas bgegs bsal lo/ /de nas gzar bu gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ste me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la raṃ bsam dgang blugs gnyis kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang raṃ bsam ste/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun brjod cing mar blug gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ agna ye a dī pya di pyā ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha nā ye swā hā/ zhes brjod de gzar bu kha sbyar te me lha'i zhal du phul/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul/ de nas bsreg rdzas rnams lag pa g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul te/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ya swā hā/ yam shing / oṃ agna ye swā hā/ mar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ya swā hā/ til lam yungs dkar/ oṃ sarba sam ba de swā hā/ zho dang byur ba'i zas mchog oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras/ oṃ badzra bi dzra ya swā hā/ 'bras so ba/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ nas/ oṃ ma hā ba la ya swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ badzra ghasma ra ya swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badzra a yu ṣe swā hā dur ba/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ya swā hā/ ku sha rnams 'bul ba'am/ yang na sngags de rnams kyis byin gyi brlabs agna ye 'ba' zhig gis phul/ gang ltar yang nyer gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor ba'i mthar bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyer 'tshe dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shintaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/

zhes las sngags kyi spel tshig sde tshan re re'i mthar brjod/ de nas chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang bstod pa sngar ltar byas te/ mar dgang gzar gang thab tu blug ste/ oṃ badzra dzwa la ram zhes ba rjod la/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo/ /'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las sogs nas/ dbus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs nas sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje dril bu spos dang bcas pas/ ma lus sems can sogs nas/ yongs dag 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol zhes pas spyan drangs te/ o āryā wa lo ke shwa ra arghaṃ sogs nas gtso bo nyid kyi dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i gtso 'khor gsum yig cha ltar bya/ de'i mtha' skor du rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ lha thams cad 'dzum zhing zhi ba 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsam la/ de nas gzar bu gnyis blangs te/ lha thams cad kyi zhal cung zad gdangs pa sogs sngar ltar gsal btab ste/ oṃ ma ṇi pangme hūm̐ḥ zhes lan 'ga' zhig brjod pas mar la sngags te/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyi blug gzar gyi mar blug pas dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ o agna ye a dī pya dī pya zhes sogs swā hā'i gong du bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i zhes sogs spel tshig gong ltar brjod de/ gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la lha thams cad kyi zhal du dus gcig la phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum la sogs pas byon skyems phul/ de nas yo ga ltar mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas/ ram 'byams rgya mtsho sogs nas rol mo'i bar dang / spro na rgyal srid sna bdun 'dod yon lnga rnams kun rig ltar ro/

/bstod pa ni/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs ci shes pas bstod/ de nas yam shing nas brtsams te bsreg rdzas rnams sde tshan re re'i thog mar so so'i bo dhi brikṣa sogs pa'i sngags gsum mam lnga la sogs pa dang / mjug tu spel tshig gong ltar brjod cing brgya rtsa la sogs pa ji tsam 'byor ba phul/ rdzas thams cad ma ṇi 'ba' zhig gis phul/ de nas til dkar nag mdun du 'dus byas la bdag gzhan gyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa til nag la thim/ dkar po la shes bya'i sgrib pa thim/ mar la de ma yin pa'i sgrib pa rnams thim zhes brjod cing bsam la/ ma ṇi bzlos shing phul bas sdig sgrib thams cad tshig nas bde ba chen po'i ngo bor bsam/ bsnyen pa kha bskong la bsnyen pa ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha'i grangs 'bul dgos pas brgya phyag re'i mtshams su gong gi spel tshig sbyar te til 'ba' zhig phul/ bsnyen pa dung song na zla ba'i bar du dgos pa sogs rigs pas dpyad do/ /rdzas rnams kyi grangs dang yam shing dang mar ni me'i tshod dang sbyar te sgrub g.yog gis logs nas 'bul/ bsreg rdzas rnams rdzogs pa dang gong byon skyems skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blugs gsum 'bul mchod pa rnams kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs te/ mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba rol mo'i bar dang bstod pa bya/ 'das pa'i gtor ma bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang / mtshan sngags kyi mthar oṃ a kā ro lan gsum/ mchod bstod bya/ jo bo thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub dang / byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab bo/ /yig brgya ci nus dang ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces sogs kyis mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra muḥ zhes dang mtheb srin gyi se gol gyi sgras/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ srin lag gis thab kyi rdul cung zad blangs la dpral bar bskus te dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo/ /gsum pa rjes ni thab tu mar blug gzar gang dgang gzar la reg pa dang bcas pas blug la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ zhes brjod de/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsam la/ bsreg rdzas rnams kyi lhag ma bdun nam bcu gcig nyer gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor ba phul/ mthar byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar dgang blug gsum gang ba'i sbyin sreg tu phul/ me lha 'khor bcas la gtor ma gcig bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyi brlabs/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogs lan gsum mam lngas phul mtshan sngags re re nas sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs dang / spro na tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyis sras sogs kyis kyang bstod la/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi bar chad dang sngags lhag chad gyi nyes pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ yig brgya lan gsum gyi lhag chad kha bskang / bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyi gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/

/bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ oṃ agna ye gatstshaḥzhes dang / dbyug gu rtse gsum phyag rgya phyir bskyed de/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs kyi gnas gsum bsrung / dge ba 'di yis skye bo sogs kyi smon lam ci shes dang / che ba'i che mchog sogs kyi bkra shis bya'o/ /mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa yin na me ma shi'i bar du mi bsgul shi ba dang gzhan reg tu mi gzhug par rang gis phyags la thal ba 'dod pa rnams la'ang sbyin zhing lhag ma 'bab chu sogs par dor/ thun mong gi dngos grub tsam la 'phral du phyags pas rung ngo / /thab kyi shul dang nye 'khor thams cad dri zhim po'i chus byugs te/ me tog la sogs pa gtor la bkra shis bya'o// ༈ /rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg ni/ rgyas pa'i thab lag len ltar bya/ dus snga dro/ pan dza li sogs la bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis 'dug yam shing tsher ma can ma yin pa'i 'bras bu can gyi shing khru gang ba'o/ /bsreg rdzas gtso bo zas mchog dang tshe rgyas pa la dur ba'o/ /rdzas gzhan rnams 'dra/ bshom gyi go rim/ yam shing mar dang zas mchog til sogs/ rgyan gos ser po bya/ dgang blugs rin chen khu chur gyis bzung 'jig rten pa'i me lha zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ser po la 'od zer ser po 'phro ba/ rigs bdag rin 'byung / spel tshig tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ 'das pa'i lha gtso bo la rigs bdag rin 'byung / lha rnams 'dzum zhing mdangs dang 'od zer ser po 'phro bas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa rgyas pa'i las mdzad par bsam/ bsreg rdzas rnams grangs brgya dang brgyad re'i mtshams su spel tshig bya/ rdzas gtso bo zas mchog gi dūr ba la grangs sog cho ga'i chings sngar zhi ba dang 'dra'o// //dbang gi sbyin sreg gi thab lag len ltar bya/

rgyan gos dmar/ yam shing shing skyur po sor brgyad pa bya/ bsreg rdzas gtso bo me tog dmar po'am 'bras dmar por bsgyur ba/ bshom gyi go rim/ yam shing mar dang me tog dmar/ /zas mchog til so nas dang gro/ sogs/ dus dgong mo/ /padma'i 'dug stangs bya/ padma'i khu tshur gyi dgang blugs bzung / 'jig rten pa'i me lha zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dmar po las 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ bsreg rdzas me tog dmar po sogs la grangs bzung / lnga bcu re'i mtshams su spel tshig rgyal po yul 'khor grong khyer la sogs pa wa shaṃ ku ru swā hā/ 'das pa'i me lha gtso la 'od dpag med kyi dbu brgyan/ lha rnams 'od zer dmar po 'phro zhing sdud pas 'gro ba dbang du sdud pa'i las mdzad/ cho ga'i chings snga ma'i rigs pas shes so// //drag po'i sbyin sreg ni drag po'i thabs lag len ltar dang / yam shing tsher ma can gyi shing sor bcu pa/ khyad par gyi rdzas/ sha khrag dug la sogs pa/ go rim mchod rdzas g.yas/ bsreg rdzas g.yon yam shing / sha khrag la sogs til zas chog sogs/ stan med pa'am srab pa/ kha lhor blta/ dus nyin phyed nam phyed/ gos rgyan nag g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang / rdo rje khu tshur gyi dgang blugs bzung 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor nag po las 'od zer nag po 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pa dbu rgyan/ spel tshig gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ 'das pa'i lha gtso bo la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ mdangs dang 'od zer nag po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi dgra bgegs la sogs pa tshar gcod pa'i las mdzad/ grangs drug cu'i mtshams su spel tshig rdzas rnams lag pa g.yon pas dbul/ khyad par gyi rdzas stong la sogs pa dbul/ gzhan phal cher snga ma'i rigs pas shes so/ /de ltar rgyas dang dbang drag gi /me dang thab kyi dbyibs la sogs/

/rgyas par sngags gzhung rgya mtsho dang / /mthong brgyud lag len las shes gyis/ /sdig sbyong gi sbyin sreg chen mo sogs gzhan du shes par bya'o// ༈ /nang gi sbyin sreg ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs khar thugs rje chen po mtshon gang ba gcig bsam/ zas la bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bsdus la/ lag pa dgang gzar/ kha hoṃ khung du bsam/ gsol bas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad tshig nas ye shes pa'i zhal du bde ba'i ngo bor gsol bar bsam/ de nas ye shes pa rang la bsdu/ dam tshig pa mi dmigs par bsam// ༈ /gsang ba'i sbyin sreg ni/ rang byung blta ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /rnam pa a'am hūm̐ gcig gzhug /'phro 'du gnyis med me gcig sbar/ /zag bcas nyon mongs thams cad sreg /tshig pa med na bde ba yin/ /me dang bsreg rdzas gnyis su med/ /sreg mkhan med na tshig pa yin// ༈ /de kho na nyid kyi sbyin sreg ni/ mtha' bral stong pa'i hom khung du/ /rang rig gsal ba'i me gcig sbar/ /the tshom yid gnyis gnyi ka sreg /bsgrub bya sgrub byed gnyi ka tshig/ ༈ /zhar byung gi sbyin sreg ni/ nang nub kyi lto g.yo ba'i dus su/ me'i nang du ma las nyi ma bsam/ de'i steng du hrīḥlas thugs rje chen po bskyed/ bud shing la sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bsdus la me btang bas ye shes kyi zhal du sdig sgrib tshig nas bde ba'i ngo bor gsol bar bsam/ de ni zhar byung gi sbyin sreg go /de ltar thugs rje chen po yi/ /sbyin sreg cho ga sbyar ba'i dges/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don du ni/ /las bzhi'i 'phrin las lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di ni don gnyer mang pos yun ring por bskul zhing / nye char bla ma rin chen grags pas gser gyi me tog dang bcas bskul nas/ ma ṇi ba sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'tsho byed rin chen phun tshogs kyis bgyis so//
